summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Relio CRM application. All major features working excellently with beautiful Neo-Claymorphism design implementation.

minor_issues.issue: Initial load shows 0 contact rows, but search/filter functionality works correctly
Navigation from contacts list to detail page has timeout issue, but direct URL access works

passed_tests: Dashboard page loads with greeting, morning delta, pulse bar, priority actions, tier breakdown, weekly report card
Sidebar navigation works - all nav links navigate correctly
Contacts page loads with search and filter functionality
Contact detail page (/contacts/c1) loads with stats, AI briefing, pipeline stage selector, notes, threads
Pipeline page loads with 4 kanban columns and 10 contacts in correct stages
Drafts page loads with draft list sidebar (6 drafts) and composer area
Network page loads with force-directed graph visualization and filter controls
Settings page loads with sidebar navigation (Account, Integrations, Notifications, AI, Security)
All pages have proper data-testid attributes on interactive elements
Tab navigation on contacts page works
Warm orange/brown color palette consistent throughout
